articles.title: A falling stock is not always cheap: Kotak explains the role of earnings and valuations
articles.content: Kotak Institutional Equities argues that stock prices are driven by earnings expectations and PE multiples rather than market flows or liquidity. Rebutting myths about FPI outflows and IPOs draining secondary market cash, the brokerage highlights business fundamentals and mental DCF valuations as the true price drivers.

articles.title: FM Sitharaman's LTCG tax remarks lift Sensex by 1,000 points. Can markets hope for a review?
articles.content: Indian equities rallied on Tuesday, with the Sensex surging over 1,000 points after Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman said discussions around long-term capital gains tax (LTCG) and securities transaction tax (STT) were ongoing. IT stocks also supported gains, led by HCL Tech and TCS. However, mixed broader-market trends, elevated crude prices and inflation concerns continued to temper investor sentiment.

Investors increasingly demand sustainable revenues and profits, questioning whether massive AI investments will deliver expected returns.

articles.title: CoinSwitch Ventures goes global as BlackLane Capital, plans to back startups with cheques of up to $5 million
articles.content: CoinSwitch’s investment arm, CoinSwitch Ventures, has rebranded as BlackLane Capital, expanding beyond crypto and Web3 to invest in early-stage startups across fintech, enterprise infrastructure, consumer applications and digital assets. The firm plans to invest up to $5 million per startup and aims to enable over $100 million in startup funding over the next five years through its investments and partner network. It has previously backed more than 26 startups under its Web3-focused mandate.

articles.title: Nvidia’s share of China AI chip market falls to 34% as Huawei gains ground
articles.content: Nvidia's share of China's AI chip market dropped to 34% in the first half of 2026 due to US export restrictions. Domestic competitors like Huawei increased their market presence significantly during this period. The total AI accelerator shipments in China reached over 2 million units, with non-GPU shipments surpassing GPU sales for the first time.

articles.title: Mortgage hedging adds selling pressure to US Treasury market as yields surge
articles.content: Rising US Treasury yields and mortgage rates have triggered increased mortgage-related hedging, adding selling pressure to the bond market. Oil prices, inflation expectations, and Federal Reserve policy remain key drivers of yields.
